objective: Ground the exact stable closure boundary for the three implementation defects proven after the prevention-system plan passed: worktree-safe host interception, an authoritative recurring-action eligibility denominator, and executable materialized contracts for all 25 registered sequence owners.
research_questions: Which Codex-owned launch boundary can enforce PreToolUse interception in ordinary repositories and Git worktrees without depending on project hook discovery or reading credentials?
Which durable controller fact makes recurring-action eligibility reproducible before dispatch and therefore makes the registered-use denominator authoritative?
Which exact source evidence and materialized fields are required to turn each of the 25 owner contract identifiers into an executable typed owner without inferring behavior from prose?
in_scope: the three recorded implementation gaps and only the original requirement IDs attached to them
mcp-agents-workflow Codex launch, tool translation, and host-hook boundaries
memory-knowledge prevention contracts, event ledger, registry, metrics, owner descriptors, migration manifest, sequence catalog, and authoritative owner implementations
official OpenAI Codex hook schemas, discovery behavior, worktree behavior, configuration, and authentication boundaries
exclusions: any fourth defect, unrelated cleanup, deployment, commit, push, secret access, credential copying, phase-ledger change, or external message
implementation planning or code edits during research
inventing parameter, command, budget, effect, reconciliation, terminal, recurrence, or authentication facts not established by authoritative evidence
supplied_input: The approved implementation found three additional defects: project-local Codex hooks are not durable in task worktrees; recurring-action eligibility has no persisted authoritative fact; and the 25 owner manifest rows name contract IDs but do not materialize their executable constants. Research must identify a stable, bounded, implementable closure for exactly these defects.
terminal_rules: PASS requires all three lenses to pass the same candidate and envelope hashes, a fresh adjudicator with no research-actionable finding, every planner obligation READY, exact package validation, and zero active agent slots.
GAPS means research-stage corrections remain inside this frozen charter.
BLOCKED means required accessible evidence or a named approval route is unavailable.
CAP_REACHED means the shared time, round, attempt, retry, or repeated-fingerprint cap fired.
